calculation_handling.description: Amending By-law 1075-2026, item 33, replaces regulation 150.8.60.60(7) with the text keyed in the (7) unit.
calculation_handling.gaps: Amendment instruction (replacement); the operative text is the (7) unit. "33" is the item number of the amending by-law, recorded as count_or_ordinal_not_a_limit in case it is not treated as a regulation number.

calculation_handling.description: Wall-mounted equipment (vents, pipes, utility equipment, satellite dishes, antennae) on a laneway suite building may encroach up to 0.6 m into a required setback, if it stays at least 0.3 m from the lot line.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 0.3 m minimum distance from the lot line is a condition on the encroachment (it would be encroachment_clearance_m, a different target with a min bound); there is no threshold token for it, so it is recorded as threshold_used_in_application rather than a second statement. Equipment encroachments do not change the building envelope.

150.8.60.60(7)@1075-2026.explanation: As replaced by By-law 1075-2026: equipment mounted on the walls of a laneway suite (vents, pipes, utility equipment, satellite dishes, antennae) may stick out up to 0.6 m into the required setback, but must stay at least 0.3 m from the lot line.
